title: 3rd Stopping Place 2nd Truth From The Comprehensiveness Of Mercifulness To Unity And Oneness

questions.question: In the passage, what is the sunlight example used to help explain?
questions.answer: It helps explain Allah’s unity and oneness.

questions.question: What does the sun’s light do that makes it a picture of unity?
questions.answer: It reaches and covers everything that faces it.

questions.question: Which kinds of things show the sun’s reflection in the example?
questions.answer: Bright and clear things, even tiny drops of water.

questions.question: When people see the sun’s light spread everywhere, what do they understand about the sun?
questions.answer: They understand that there is one sun and it is unique.

questions.question: What does the reflection of the sun in many objects show besides the sun’s existence?
questions.answer: It shows that its qualities appear near many things at once.

questions.question: In the comparison, what takes the place of sunlight?
questions.answer: Allah’s wide mercy takes the place of sunlight.

questions.question: What does mercy covering all things prove about the Merciful One?
questions.answer: It proves that He is one and has no partner.

questions.question: According to the passage, where are signs of Allah’s Names especially seen?
questions.answer: They are seen in everything, especially in living things, and most especially in human beings.

questions.question: What does life give to each person in this passage?
questions.answer: It gives each person a kind of broad connection to the whole universe.

questions.question: How does that broad connection support belief in Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: It shows that the One who gives life and mercy is active with all things at the same time.

questions.question: What does Allah show throughout the universe by means of mercy?
questions.answer: He shows the greatness and beauty of His glory.

questions.question: What does Allah gather into each living creature?
questions.answer: He places examples of many of His blessings into each one.

questions.question: What special thing is said about human beings in this part?
questions.answer: Human beings carry many kinds of Allah’s blessings in a concentrated way.

questions.question: Why is the seed-and-melon example given?
questions.answer: To show that the one who makes a small part must also be the one who makes the whole it comes from.

questions.question: Why would it be impossible for a different maker to make the seed?
questions.answer: Because the seed is drawn from the melon with exact knowledge, balance, and wisdom that belong to the maker of the whole melon.

questions.question: In the final comparison, what are the cosmos, the earth, and man compared to?
questions.answer: The cosmos is like a tree or garden, the earth is like a fruit or melon, and man is like a seed.

questions.question: What final conclusion does the passage make from that comparison?
questions.answer: The One who creates and cares for the smallest living being must also be the Creator of the whole earth and the whole universe.

questions.question: What natural thing is used at the start of the passage as an example?
questions.answer: The light of the sun.

questions.question: Why is the sun called a sign of unity in this passage?
questions.answer: Because its light reaches all the things turned toward it.

questions.question: What in objects shows that they receive something from the sun?
questions.answer: Their brightness and the reflected light, warmth, and colors.

questions.question: If someone notices sunlight in many different places, what judgment would he make?
questions.answer: He would say the sun is one and not many separate suns.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by saying the sun seems close to all things?
questions.answer: It teaches that one source can show its effects everywhere.

questions.question: What does Allah’s mercy do in a way similar to sunlight?
questions.answer: It surrounds and reaches all things.

questions.question: What belief is strengthened by seeing mercy spread over everything?
questions.answer: Belief that Allah is one and without any partner.

questions.question: What is found in everything under the cover of mercy?
questions.answer: Signs of many of Allah’s Names and a special nearness of His being.

questions.question: In which creatures is this seen most clearly, according to the passage?
questions.answer: In living creatures, especially in people.

questions.question: How does life make an individual connected to the universe?
questions.answer: It gives a person a wide reach so he relates to many parts of creation.

questions.question: What does this wide connection tell us about Allah’s action?
questions.answer: It tells us that He is present with all things and works in all things.

questions.question: How does the passage describe Allah’s care for each individual while still caring for the whole universe?
questions.answer: He gives special care to each one without harming the order of the whole.

questions.question: What is placed in every member of living species?
questions.answer: Samples of many blessings.

questions.question: How is man described in relation to blessings?
questions.answer: Man is a place where many different blessings are gathered together in a compact way.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the melon and seed example?
questions.answer: The maker of the seed must be the maker of the melon too.

questions.question: What does the seed example show about knowledge and wisdom?
questions.answer: Making even a small seed needs exact knowledge and wise planning.

questions.question: What does the last sentence of the passage say about the Creator of a tiny living thing?
questions.answer: He must also be the Creator of the earth and the whole cosmos.

questions.question: What main Islamic belief is the whole passage trying to prove?
questions.answer: That Allah is one and unique.

questions.question: What example from everyday creation is used first to explain this idea?
questions.answer: The example of the sun and its light.

questions.question: What makes a shiny object important in the sun example?
questions.answer: It shows the sun’s reflection and points back to one source.

questions.question: Why are even drops of water mentioned?
questions.answer: To show that even very small things can reflect signs of one sun.

questions.question: What can a person infer from seeing the sun reflected in many places?
questions.answer: One sun can reach many places at the same time.

questions.question: In the same way, what reaches all things in the spiritual meaning of the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s mercy reaches all things.

questions.question: What does the spread of mercy across everything prove?
questions.answer: It proves the unity of the Merciful One and that He has no partner.

questions.question: Besides mercy, what else appears in things according to the passage?
questions.answer: Signs of many Divine Names.

questions.question: Which part of creation is given special attention in this discussion?
questions.answer: Living beings, and especially human beings.

questions.question: What gift arising from life is given to each individual?
questions.answer: A broad ability to relate to the whole universe.

questions.question: How does this gift help a person think about Allah?
questions.answer: It helps him see that Allah cares for all things and is near to all.

questions.question: What does Allah do in every member of living species through His oneness?
questions.answer: He gathers signs of many blessings in each one.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the parts and tools of living beings?
questions.answer: They are arranged in an ordered way.

questions.question: What does Allah show to each individual creature?
questions.answer: A special and personal care.

questions.question: How is man different in this description?
questions.answer: In man, many kinds of blessings are shown together in a concentrated form.

questions.question: In the melon example, why must the seed’s maker be the same as the melon’s maker?
questions.answer: Because the seed comes from the melon through careful measure and wisdom that belong to the one who made the whole.

questions.question: When the cosmos is compared to a tree or garden, what role is given to man?
questions.answer: Man is compared to a seed.

questions.question: What big conclusion follows from the tree, fruit, and seed comparison?
questions.answer: The Lord of the smallest living being is also the Lord of the whole universe.

questions.question: Which created thing is used as a comparison at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: The sun.

questions.question: What three things from the sun are said to appear in reflecting objects?
questions.answer: Its light, warmth, and colors.

questions.question: What does the spread of these signs tell an observer?
questions.answer: That they come from one sun.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the sun’s nearness to things in the example?
questions.answer: It says its signs appear as if very near to them, like in their mirrors.

questions.question: What heavenly example is then used to teach about Allah?
questions.answer: The wide-reaching mercy of the Merciful One.

questions.question: What does this mercy show about Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: It shows He is one and has no partner at all.

questions.question: What is found in all things beneath this mercy?
questions.answer: Traces of many Divine Names and a special manifestation from Allah.

questions.question: Where are these traces especially noticed?
questions.answer: In living creatures, especially in human beings.

questions.question: What effect does life have on an individual person?
questions.answer: It gives the person a broad relationship with the whole universe.

questions.question: What does that relationship prove about Allah?
questions.answer: It proves that He is with all things and works through all things.

questions.question: Through the unity of mercy, what does Allah display across the universe and the earth?
questions.answer: The greatness and beauty of His glory.

questions.question: What does Allah collect together in each living creature?
questions.answer: Samples of His many favors.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s care for each individual?
questions.answer: It says each one receives special care.

questions.question: How is the order of the whole universe affected by this special care?
questions.answer: It is not damaged or broken.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the melon and seed comparison?
questions.answer: To show that the one who makes the small, packed part must be the maker of the larger whole.

questions.question: What qualities are needed to draw out and shape the seed properly?
questions.answer: Knowledge, wisdom, and exact balance.

questions.question: If the universe is like a garden and the earth is like a fruit, what does that suggest about the Creator?
questions.answer: It suggests the same Creator manages the largest things and the smallest living beings.

questions.question: What is the final certainty stated at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: The Creator and Sustainer of even the smallest living creature is the Creator of the earth and the whole cosmos.

questions.question: What picture from nature opens the passage?
questions.answer: The picture of sunlight shining on many things.

questions.question: Why is sunlight called a picture of unity?
questions.answer: Because one light reaches many things together.

questions.question: What kinds of objects show the sun’s reflection?
questions.answer: Clear and shiny objects, even water drops.

questions.question: What would a careful observer learn from seeing these reflections everywhere?
questions.answer: He would learn that one sun is behind them all.

questions.question: What does the example teach about one thing being present by its effects?
questions.answer: It teaches that one source can make its qualities appear in many places.

questions.question: In the lesson of the passage, what works like that one source?
questions.answer: Allah’s all-reaching mercy.

questions.question: What does this all-reaching mercy prove?
questions.answer: It proves Allah’s unity and that no partner shares His work.

questions.question: What else, besides mercy, is seen in everything?
questions.answer: Signs of Allah’s Names.

questions.question: Which created beings are highlighted most in this part?
questions.answer: Living beings, especially human beings.

questions.question: What does life cause each individual to do?
questions.answer: It makes each one connected and related to the whole universe.

questions.question: Why is that important for understanding tawhid?
questions.answer: Because it points to one Lord who gives life and manages everything together.

questions.question: What does Allah gather in every member of living species?
questions.answer: Examples of many blessings.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the parts and equipment of living creatures?
questions.answer: They are arranged in an ordered and fitting way.

questions.question: What special honor is given to each individual creature?
questions.answer: Each one receives a special kind of care and attention.

questions.question: How are human beings described in relation to blessings?
questions.answer: They are a compact place where many kinds of blessings are shown.

questions.question: Why can’t someone other than the melon’s maker make the seed, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because the seed is taken from the melon and formed with the same deep wisdom and control.

questions.question: In the final comparison, what is the earth like?
questions.answer: It is like a fruit or a melon.

questions.question: What overall lesson should we take from the final comparison?
questions.answer: The Lord who creates a tiny living thing is surely the Lord of the whole universe.

questions.question: What example does the passage use first to make a hard idea easier to understand?
questions.answer: It uses the example of the sun and its light.

questions.question: How does the sun’s light act as a sign of unity?
questions.answer: It spreads over all the things facing it.

questions.question: What do bright objects and water drops show in this example?
questions.answer: They show reflections that point back to the one sun.

questions.question: What conclusion should a person reach after seeing these many reflections?
questions.answer: He should conclude that the sun is one and unique.

questions.question: What does the example suggest about nearness?
questions.answer: It suggests that one source can seem close to many things through its effects.

questions.question: According to the passage, what surrounds all things in a similar way?
questions.answer: The vast mercy of Allah surrounds all things.

questions.question: What truth about Allah is shown by this mercy?
questions.answer: That He is one and has no partner.

questions.question: Under the cover of mercy, what is found in all things?
questions.answer: Manifestations of many of Allah’s Names and a special sign of His presence.

questions.question: Which group receives the strongest attention in this explanation?
questions.answer: Human beings, after living things in general.

questions.question: What does life give to a person in relation to the universe?
questions.answer: It gives him a wide connection to the whole universe.

questions.question: What does that wide connection prove about Allah’s action?
questions.answer: It proves that He deals with all things together and is present with them.

questions.question: What does Allah show throughout the universe by the broadness of His mercy?
questions.answer: He shows the glory and beauty of His greatness.

questions.question: What is put into each living creature through His oneness?
questions.answer: Samples of all kinds of blessings.

questions.question: What two things are said about the way living beings are equipped?
questions.answer: Their parts are arranged well, and each one receives special care.

questions.question: What is special about man in this discussion?
questions.answer: Man gathers many different blessings in a concentrated form.

questions.question: How does the seed help explain the place of man in the universe?
questions.answer: Just as a seed holds a compact form of the fruit, man holds a compact form of many blessings.

questions.question: What must be true about the maker of the seed?
questions.answer: He must be the same one who made the whole melon.

questions.question: What final belief does the passage lead to about the Creator of the smallest living thing?
questions.answer: He is also the Creator and Sustainer of the whole earth and the whole cosmos.
